what_happened.line: The ad hoc Open Space Advisory Committee began updating the town's expired open space and recreation plan; no votes on the plan were taken.
Members set a meeting calendar: Tuesday, June 19, then fourth Wednesdays through October, with a wrap-up around November 7.
Members volunteered to write sections on community setting, environmental inventory and inventory of lands; the chair takes the maps.
The chair will rework the survey questions and plan to use SurveyMonkey plus paper copies sent with tax bills.
A presenter said Wallace Park upgrades could have been reimbursed by the state had the plan been current.

why_it_matters: A current open space plan is what makes the town eligible for state land and park grants, which reimburse part of purchases and upgrades that would otherwise fall on the town budget, mostly taxes.
Residents will be asked to answer the community survey, which is planned to arrive on paper with tax bills as well as online.
